_provenance.what: 400 well-known technology companies, each with a one-line description and the roles it typically hires for.
_provenance.how: Written from a language model's general knowledge on 2026-09-17. Nothing in this file was researched, sourced, or checked against any company's own material.
_provenance.accuracy: Expect errors. stage, size, category, hiring_for and founder_led are impressions rather than facts, and some of them are certainly wrong. Do not quote any entry as a fact about the company it names, and do not treat a company's absence or presence as meaningful.
_provenance.purpose: It exists so the ranking pipeline has something to run against out of the box. Replace it with sourced data before any answer computed from it matters.
_provenance.no_live_postings: There are no job postings here. Nothing in this file says a company is hiring now.
